<issue>
Setting bottom_margin on Section raises NameError

#### Description

When trying to set the `bottom_margin` property on a Section object, a `NameError` is raised because `pgMar` is referenced before it's defined.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches

# Create a new document
doc = Document()

# Get the section
section = doc.sections[0]

# Try to set bottom margin - this will fail
section.bottom_margin = Inches(0.75)
```

This raises:
```
NameError: name 'pgMar' is not defined
```

The same issue occurs when setting the bottom margin to any value, including `None`.
</issue>
